svg.title: LSM compaction merge step — CDC materialized rows
svg.desc: Three input SSTables hold change-data-capture updates streamed from an upstream database. A k-way merge keeps the row version with the highest LSN, drops superseded versions, and removes rows whose upstream DELETE has propagated. The output is the materialized current-row view that downstream applications query.
svg.text: key = table:pk · value = row version · seq# rises with upstream LSN
highest LSN wins; tombstones propagate upstream DELETEs
